title: Siege of Tessalit
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Tessalit", at revision 1370745744, opens: "The siege of Tessalit occurred in early 2012 during the Tuareg rebellion in Mali. Amachach military base, located in Tessalit, was defended by roughly 800 Malian soldiers commanded by Colonel Kassim Goita." Wikidata item Q4474075, whose own description reads "2012 battle". That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does.
